portal_description:
The Pacemaker cluster resource manager is a collection of technologies working together to maintain data integrity and application availability in the event of failures. 

Bug Fix(es):

* A Pacemaker Remote node that needs to be fenced while it is in the process of shutting down will be fenced once rather than get into a fence loop. (BZ#1734066)

abstract:
The Pacemaker cluster resource manager is a collection of technologies working together to maintain data integrity and application availability in the event of failures. 

Bug Fix(es):

* A Pacemaker Remote node that needs to be fenced while it is in the process of shutting down will be fenced once rather than get into a fence loop. (BZ#1734066)
